unscored: 16 of 17 PR pushes in the window came from bots (renovate[bot]), and only pushes people make are timed; 5 are needed.

layers.note: Layers inside a package need every file: run `scripts/graph/` in a checkout for layers and what triggers what

fixes.text: Run only what a change can reach: no path filters or affected-only selection on PR workflows
"sonar" runs 12 min in one job: shard it
12% of PR heads went green only on a rerun: track and fix flakes
Jobs wait 182 s for a runner at p90: GitHub-hosted runners are often slow to start, so price a faster provider
Cancel superseded PR runs: no concurrency with cancel-in-progress
Move broad checks to a scheduled sweep

notes.text: ci-doctor's guides are strongest for TypeScript and Rust. For C# it applies the principles, without a C#-specific page
